column1: # The Java and Kotlin libraries inside the APKs, which the licence screen lists (W7, part 2). Kept by hand and
# held by android/app/build.gradle.kts (checkJvmComponents<Variant>, run with every APK): the build fails when a
# module of an edition's runtime classpath has no row here, and when a row of an edition covers none of its
# modules. Columns, by tabs: a Maven group, group:artifact, or group.* for the group and the groups under it; the
# name shown; the licence as an SPDX expression; the editions (all, or basic, lite and advanced by commas); the
# file under licences/ in the APK that holds the licence's text.

column2: Jetpack Compose: runtime, UI, foundation, animation, Material 3
